acceptedApiFacts: Native StartCarryThing treats job.count as quantity; our order-ID jobs use custom pickup.
Actual items in spawned containers can be reserved directly; reserving only the cabinet is insufficient.
Map-spawned stock must be distinguished by Spawned before inspecting holdingOwner.
Worker hand capacity and buyer inventory weight are separate checks.
rejectedOrLimitedClaims: SAFE-SEQUENCE point 10 repeats a false blanket quality-loss claim. ThingWithComps.SplitOff calls PostSplitOff; CompQuality copies qualityInt. Actual book and Excellent apparel identity are tested in game.
Point 5's spawned-parent GotoThing flag is only necessary when targeting an unspawned item. This implementation targets its spawned storage building instead.
The state model passes 24 cases and 6 mutations but is not implementation or runtime proof.
The model's save_load handler is pass; it does not exercise real Scribe serialization.
The model does not enforce all declared inputs (for example storage_active and occupied hands) and uses float pricing. Production guards and live tests remain authoritative.
Model item-quality preservation is an assigned state, not evidence about every mod's metadata.
accounting: All successfully placed retail receipts belong to the colony. No delivery commission or buyout credit is invented from the full price of sold goods.
testScope: See DeliveryStageVerification.json for current-DLL results; older full regression and public retail reports retain their original hashes.
